title: Page front matter
description: The front matter keys the engine reads (ADR 0024, rule 3). Every key is optional; an unknown key is kept and passed to the layout, never rejected.

agent.description: Instructions for agents that edit this page.

edit.description: `false` for a generated page that must be changed at its source.

notes.description: A short instruction for the agent.

source.description: The file to edit instead of this page.

canonical_url.description: The original URL of the page if it was first published elsewhere; the canonical link and `og:url` use it.

description.description: One sentence for the meta description, the `llms.txt` entry, and the search excerpt.

dir.description: Text direction. Unset, it comes from the page's `lang`.

image.description: The page's social image: a path on this site or an `https` URL. `og:image` uses it.

lang.description: Language of the page as a BCP 47 tag, such as `en` or `fa`. Unset, it comes from the language prefix of its folder, then from `lang` in `slipway.yml`.

last_modified_at.description: The date the page last changed; the page's `<url>/index.json` reports it as `lastModified`.

layout.description: The theme layout that renders the page. Unset, it comes from `defaults`, then the theme's default layout. An unknown name is an error.

og.description: `false` drops the page's Open Graph and Twitter card tags and the image in its structured data.

order.description: Sort order among siblings in navigation built from folders. Pages without it follow, sorted by title.

permalink.description: The output URL, a path starting with `/`. Unset, the URL comes from the file path: `guide/install.md` and `guide/install/index.md` both give `/guide/install/`.

published.description: `false` keeps the page out of the build.

redirect_from.description: Old paths that redirect to this page.

redirect_to.description: A path on the site or an `https` URL this page redirects to; its body is not rendered.

search.description: `false` leaves the page out of the search index.

status.description: Lifecycle of the page. The engine checks the value; the theme decides how to show it.

title.description: Page title. Without it, the first `h1` of the body; without that, the file name.

translation_key.description: Links a page to its translations. Use the same key on every translation.

updated.description: The date the page was last substantially edited; `sitemap.xml` uses it as `lastmod`.
